Alexander Pedals browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal Alexander Pedals Hot Pink Drive Published on December 4, 2018 Alexander Pedals overdrive pedal Information Alexander Pedals Hot. Pink. Drive. The sound of all your neon nights on the Sunset Strip, now in a convenient and easy to swallow form. Limited Edition for 2018 - hand-assembled and VERY pink. Controls: Level: Controls the output level of the pedal. Drive: Adjusts the gain and distortion of the pedal. Bass / Treble: Passive two-band tone stack, voiced like a British amplifier. Contour: Active midrange filter, boost or scoop mids up to 18dB. Bypass Switching: Hot Pink features true bypass switching using a latching relay and a soft-touch bypass footswitch. Power on while holding the footswitch to enable the bypass pop-stop function (2 blinks for on, 1 blink for off.) Hot Pink remembers your settings when powered off. Power Supply: Hot Pink requires a DC power supply with a 2.1mm pin, center negative. Hot Pink will operate on power supply voltages up to 18V for increased headroom, and does not use a battery. Hot Pink should work fine on a multi-pedal "daisy chain" connector, but if you encounter excessive noise or hum try a separate power supply. Hot Pink requires approx. 20mA.
